dimension_description: Specific heat capacity measures how much energy a kilogram of material needs to change temperature by one kelvin. This scale is good for intuition about why water moderates climate, why metals heat quickly, and why gases and cryogens behave so differently. Values depend on temperature and phase, so representative conditions matter.
